issues.detail: The Greek 'ερχεται προς το φως' (comes toward/into the light) is rendered as 'đến cùng ánh sáng' (comes to the end of the light / comes with the light). The Vietnamese word 'cùng' can imply 'to the end' or 'together with', which slightly alters the directional movement 'towards' intended in the Greek.
